ports.note: Every port a chart can draw, declared always, and none of them required. A chart draws what it is given, so which ports exist is not a question for the practitioner to answer before they have the shape -- the treatment map_output took on 2026-10-14 and table_output on 2026-10-27. `series` remains reachable only on a workflow saved with inputMode 'series'; a Cases by period table connected to `records` draws the same curve, because the shape that arrives decides and not the port it arrived on.

ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. The transmission tree asserts fw:TransmissionTree with its columns and counts, declared in ontology/runtime.ttl; listed here as none because this widget is defined in core.ts#TYPES, which the coupling check cannot attribute.

changes.description: Draws a population pyramid: two groups back to back by band, the youngest at the bottom, counts read on both sides, and the rows where the group column is blank said and not drawn (experiment 210, the first of the forms it proposes; the practitioner, 2026-11-12: "We really want FW to shine and impress with its intelligent data visualizations"). Hagelloch's cases by age and gender are drawn this way.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.8.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid. 0.13.0: tests/hagelloch-transmission-tree.browser.mjs and tests/hagelloch-chains-example.browser.mjs on Chromium. 0.14.1: tests/chart-panels.test.mjs (a blank panel drawn and named; 2, 9, 10 in number order) and tests/hagelloch-people-example.browser.mjs (ages 0 to 15, the gender-blank panel, 38 bars); Chromium. 0.15.0: tests/chart-panels.test.mjs (the line, band order), tests/transmission-tree.test.mjs and tests/relate-several.test.mjs (MERS: 162 cases, 2 with several sources, 3 further links). 0.15.1: tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (estimates with their intervals, points on a line, dots and bars each counted as drawn). 0.16.0: tests/chart-pyramid.test.mjs (the two sides signed, the youngest at the bottom, the blanks said, a column of three refused) and tests/hagelloch-people-example.browser.mjs (Hagelloch's pyramid, ages 0 to 15, 11 without gender said); Chromium.

html.note: This project's own bars. Versioned by this release rather than by a library, and it emits no specification because it has none to give.
